explanation.en: England's National Health Service (NHS) became the first health system in the world to roll out a 7-minute subcutaneous immunotherapy injection (Atezolizumab) for cancer patients.
explanation.hi: इंग्लैंड की राष्ट्रीय स्वास्थ्य सेवा (NHS) ने कैंसर रोगियों के लिए 7 मिनट का इम्युनोथेरेपी इंजेक्शन शुरू किया।

question.en: Northeast Frontier Railway bagged the PMI South Asia Award for “Micro Project of the Year”. This project, the “Intrusion Detection System”, is meant to save the life of which of the following animals?
question.hi: पूर्वोत्तर सीमांत रेलवे ने 'इंट्रूजन डिटेक्शन सिस्टम' (IDS) के लिए पुरस्कार जीता। यह प्रणाली किस वन्यजीव की जान बचाने के लिए बनाई गई है?

hindiQuestion.en: Northeast Frontier Railway bagged the PMI South Asia Award for “Micro Project of the Year”. This project, the “Intrusion Detection System”, is meant to save the life of which of the following animals?
hindiQuestion.hi: पूर्वोत्तर सीमांत रेलवे ने 'इंट्रूजन डिटेक्शन सिस्टम' (IDS) के लिए पुरस्कार जीता। यह प्रणाली किस वन्यजीव की जान बचाने के लिए बनाई गई है?

explanation.en: NFR developed the optical fiber-based Intrusion Detection System (IDS) to alert loco pilots of elephants approaching railway tracks, preventing collisions.
explanation.hi: पूर्वोत्तर सीमांत रेलवे ने रेल पटरियों पर हाथियों के आने की सूचना तुरंत देने हेतु ऑप्टिकल फाइबर सेंसर आधारित घुसपैठ पहचान प्रणाली (IDS) लागू की।

question.en: Which railway station from India got the UNESCO Asia Pacific Cultural Heritage Award?
question.hi: भारत के किस रेलवे स्टेशन को यूनेस्को एशिया प्रशांत सांस्कृतिक विरासत पुरस्कार से सम्मानित किया गया?

hindiQuestion.en: Which railway station from India got the UNESCO Asia Pacific Cultural Heritage Award?
hindiQuestion.hi: भारत के किस रेलवे स्टेशन को यूनेस्को एशिया प्रशांत सांस्कृतिक विरासत पुरस्कार से सम्मानित किया गया?

explanation.en: Mumbai's 169-year-old historic Byculla Railway Station won the UNESCO Asia-Pacific Award of Merit for Cultural Heritage Conservation.
explanation.hi: मुंबई में स्थित 169 वर्ष पुराने ऐतिहासिक भायखला रेलवे स्टेशन के जीर्णोद्धार हेतु यूनेस्को एशिया-पैसिफिक अवार्ड दिया गया।

question.en: Give the name of the popular hill fort in the Sahyadri Mountain Range that is known as “The Eagle’s Nest”.
question.hi: सह्याद्री पर्वतमाला के उस लोकप्रिय पहाड़ी किले का नाम बताइए जिसे 'चील का घोंसला' (The Eagle’s Nest) कहा जाता है?

hindiQuestion.en: Give the name of the popular hill fort in the Sahyadri Mountain Range that is known as “The Eagle’s Nest”.
hindiQuestion.hi: सह्याद्री पर्वतमाला के उस लोकप्रिय पहाड़ी किले का नाम बताइए जिसे 'चील का घोंसला' (The Eagle’s Nest) कहा जाता है?

explanation.en: Torna Fort (Prachandagad) in Pune district, captured by 16-year-old Shivaji Maharaj in 1646, was famously nicknamed 'The Eagle's Nest'.
explanation.hi: पुणे स्थित तोरणा किले (प्रचंडगढ़) को उसकी दुर्गम ऊंचाई के कारण ऐतिहासिक रूप से 'चील का घोंसला' (Eagle's Nest) कहा जाता था।

question.en: Recently, the Minister of Civil Aviation, Shri Jyotiraditya Scindia, inaugurated Utkela Airport, a regional airport under the UDAN scheme, in which of the following states of India?
question.hi: हाल ही में, नागरिक उड्डयन मंत्री ज्योतिरादित्य सिंधिया ने 'उड़ान' योजना के तहत क्षेत्रीय उत्केला हवाई अड्डे का उद्घाटन किस राज्य में किया?

hindiQuestion.en: Recently, the Minister of Civil Aviation, Shri Jyotiraditya Scindia, inaugurated Utkela Airport, a regional airport under the UDAN scheme, in which of the following states of India?
hindiQuestion.hi: हाल ही में, नागरिक उड्डयन मंत्री ज्योतिरादित्य सिंधिया ने 'उड़ान' योजना के तहत क्षेत्रीय उत्केला हवाई अड्डे का उद्घाटन किस राज्य में किया?

explanation.en: Utkela Airport in Kalahandi district, Odisha was inaugurated in August 2023 connecting Utkela with Bhubaneswar under the UDAN scheme.
explanation.hi: ओडिशा के कालाहांडी जिले में स्थित उत्केला हवाई अड्डे का शुभारंभ कर इसे भुवनेश्वर से जोड़ा गया।

question.en: The Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Award is the highest national recognition for outstanding achievements in adventure on land, sea and air. What is the cash prize for this award?
question.hi: तेनजिंग नोर्गे राष्ट्रीय साहसिक पुरस्कार साहसिक गतिविधियों के लिए सर्वोच्च राष्ट्रीय सम्मान है। इस पुरस्कार की नकद राशि कितनी है?

hindiQuestion.en: The Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Award is the highest national recognition for outstanding achievements in adventure on land, sea and air. What is the cash prize for this award?
hindiQuestion.hi: तेनजिंग नोर्गे राष्ट्रीय साहसिक पुरस्कार साहसिक गतिविधियों के लिए सर्वोच्च राष्ट्रीय सम्मान है। इस पुरस्कार की नकद राशि कितनी है?

explanation.en: The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports enhanced the cash prize for the Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Award to ₹15 lakh (along with a bronze statuette and certificate).
explanation.hi: भारत सरकार द्वारा तेनजिंग नोर्गे राष्ट्रीय साहसिक पुरस्कार की नकद राशि बढ़ाकर ₹15 लाख कर दी गई है।

question.en: Which of the following is India’s first DBOT (Design, Build, Operate and Transfer) model outdoor stadium?
question.hi: निम्नलिखित में से भारत का पहला डीबीओटी (डिजाइन, निर्माण, संचालन और हस्तांतरण) मॉडल आउटडोर स्टेडियम कौन सा है?

hindiQuestion.en: Which of the following is India’s first DBOT (Design, Build, Operate and Transfer) model outdoor stadium?
hindiQuestion.hi: निम्नलिखित में से भारत का पहला डीबीओटी (डिजाइन, निर्माण, संचालन और हस्तांतरण) मॉडल आउटडोर स्टेडियम कौन सा है?

explanation.en: The Greenfield International Stadium (The Sports Hub) in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala is India's first outdoor stadium built on DBOT (PPP) model.
explanation.hi: केरल के तिरुवनंतपुरम स्थित ग्रीनफील्ड इंटरनेशनल स्टेडियम (द स्पोर्ट्स हब) भारत का पहला डीबीओटी मॉडल स्टेडियम है।

question.en: Which bird, symbolizing power and strength, was officially declared as the national bird of the United States of America in December 2024?
question.hi: शक्ति और ताकत के प्रतीक किस पक्षी को दिसंबर 2024 में आधिकारिक तौर पर संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका का राष्ट्रीय पक्षी घोषित किया गया था?

explanation.en: In December 2024, the US Congress formally enacted the National Bird Act, officially designating the Bald Eagle as the national bird of the United States.
explanation.hi: दिसंबर 2024 में अमेरिकी संसद ने नेशनल बर्ड एक्ट पारित कर बाल्ड ईगल को आधिकारिक तौर पर संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका का राष्ट्रीय पक्षी घोषित किया।

question.en: What is the theme of World Day to Combat Desertification and Drought 2025?
question.hi: विश्व मरुस्थलीकरण एवं सूखा निवारण दिवस 2025 का विषय क्या है?

B.en: "United for Land. Our Legacy. Our Future."
B.hi: "भूमि के लिए एकजुट । हमारी विरासत । हमारा भविष्य ।"

C.hi: "भूमि को पुनर्स्थापित करें । अवसरों का लाभ उठाएँ ।"

answerText.hi: "भूमि को पुनर्स्थापित करें । अवसरों का लाभ उठाएँ ।"

explanation.en: Observed on June 17, the 2025 World Day to Combat Desertification and Drought focuses on land restoration to unlock socio-economic opportunities.
explanation.hi: 17 जून को मनाए जाने वाले विश्व मरुस्थलीकरण एवं सूखा निवारण दिवस 2025 का विषय 'भूमि को पुनर्स्थापित करें । अवसरों का लाभ उठाएँ' निर्धारित किया गया है।

question.en: Where was the 55th World Economic Forum Annual Meeting, 2025 held?
question.hi: 55 वीं विश्व आर्थिक मंच वार्षिक बैठक, 2025 कहाँ आयोजित की गई थी?

explanation.en: The 55th Annual Meeting of the World Economic Forum (WEF) was held at Davos-Klosters, Switzerland from 20 to 24 January 2025.
explanation.hi: विश्व आर्थिक मंच (WEF) की 55वीं वार्षिक बैठक 20 से 24 जनवरी 2025 को दावोस-क्लोस्टर्स (स्विट्जरलैंड) में आयोजित की गई थी।

question.en: What type of missile is the Nag Mark 2 developed by the Defence Research and Development Organization (DRDO)?
question.hi: डिफेन्स रिसर्च एण्ड डेवलपमेंट ऑर्गेनाइजेशन (डीआरडीओ) द्वारा विकसित नाग मार्क 2 किस प्रकार की मिसाइल है?

explanation.en: Nag Mark 2 is an advanced indigenous third-generation Fire-and-Forget Anti-Tank Guided Missile (ATGM) developed by DRDO with thermal imaging and top-attack capability.
explanation.hi: नाग मार्क 2 डीआरडीओ द्वारा विकसित तीसरी पीढ़ी की स्वदेशी 'फायर-एंड-फॉरगेट' एंटी-टैंक गाइडेड मिसाइल (ATGM) है।

question.en: In January 2025, who was appointed as the Vice President and General Manager for India and South Asia Beverages by PepsiCo?
question.hi: जनवरी 2025 में, पेप्सिको द्वारा भारत और दक्षिण एशिया पेय पदार्थों के लिए उपाध्यक्ष और महाप्रबंधक के रूप में किसे नियुक्त किया गया?

explanation.en: In January 2025, PepsiCo appointed veteran executive Sanjeev Chadha to lead its India and South Asia beverage business portfolio.
explanation.hi: जनवरी 2025 में पेप्सिको ने संजीव चड्ढा को भारत और दक्षिण एशिया पेय पदार्थ व्यवसाय के लिए उपाध्यक्ष व महाप्रबंधक नियुक्त किया।

question.en: Where is the Vizhinjam International Seaport situated?
question.hi: विझिंजम अंतर्राष्ट्रीय बंदरगाह कहाँ स्थित है?

explanation.en: Vizhinjam International Transshipment Deepwater Multipurpose Seaport is located at Thiruvananthapuram in Kerala.
explanation.hi: विझिंजम अंतरराष्ट्रीय डीपवाटर ट्रांसशिपमेंट बंदरगाह केरल की राजधानी तिरुवनंतपुरम के निकट स्थित है।

question.en: When did the United Kingdom officially become the 12th member of the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP)?
question.hi: यूनाइटेड किंगडम आधिकारिक तौर पर ट्रांस-पैसिफिक पार्टनरशिप के लिए व्यापक और प्रगतिशील समझौते (CPTPP) का 12 वाँ सदस्य कब बना?

explanation.en: The United Kingdom formally acceded to the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP) on December 15, 2024.
explanation.hi: यूनाइटेड किंगडम 15 दिसंबर 2024 को औपचारिक रूप से CPTPP व्यापार समझौते का 12वाँ सदस्य बना।

question.en: Which ministry released the Annual Groundwater Quality Report 2024, compiled by the Central Ground Water Board (CGWB), on December 31, 2024?
question.hi: किस मंत्रालय ने 31 दिसंबर, 2024 को केंद्रीय भूजल बोर्ड (CGWB) द्वारा संकलित वार्षिक भूजल गुणवत्ता रिपोर्ट 2024 जारी की?

A.en: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare

D.en: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
D.hi: पर्यावरण, वन और जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय

explanation.en: The Central Ground Water Board (CGWB) functions under the Union Ministry of Jal Shakti, which released the Annual Groundwater Quality Report 2024 on 31 December 2024.
explanation.hi: केंद्रीय भूजल बोर्ड (CGWB) केंद्रीय जलशक्ति मंत्रालय के अधीन कार्यरत है, जिसने 31 दिसंबर 2024 को वार्षिक भूजल गुणवत्ता रिपोर्ट जारी की।

question.en: Which country won the ICC Cricket-World Test Championship (WTC) 2025 title?
question.hi: किस देश ने ICC क्रिकेट-विश्व टेस्ट चैम्पियनशिप (WTC) 2025 का खिताब जीता?

explanation.en: The ICC World Test Championship 2023–2025 final at Lord's features the top test nations qualifying from the WTC league table.
explanation.hi: आईसीसी विश्व टेस्ट चैंपियनशिप 2023–25 चक्र के शीर्ष दावेदारों में लॉर्ड्स फाइनल हेतु प्रमुख टीमें शामिल हैं।

question.en: Which crop did Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully sprout in space, marking a milestone in space-based agricultural research?
question.hi: इंडियन स्पेस रिसर्च ऑर्गनाइजेशन (इसरो) ने अंतरिक्ष में कौन-सी फसल सफलतापूर्वक उगाई, जो अंतरिक्ष-आधारित कृषि अनुसंधान में एक मील का पत्थर साबित हुई?

explanation.en: ISRO successfully sprouted cowpea (Vigna unguiculata / लोबिया) seeds in space as part of its microgravity plant growth experiments.
explanation.hi: इसरो ने अंतरिक्षीय माइक्रोग्रैविटी वातावरण में लोबिया (Cowpea) के बीजों को सफलतापूर्वक अंकुरित कर अंतरिक्ष कृषि में बड़ी उपलब्धि हासिल की।

questions.question: Which of the following is not a neighbouring country of India?
questions.hindiQuestion: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा भारत का पड़ोसी देश नहीं है?
questions.explanation: United Arab Emirates (UAE) is located in Western Asia (Arabian Peninsula) and does not share a land or direct maritime border with India. Bhutan, Nepal, and Bangladesh share direct land borders with India.

questions.question: Which was the first Indian state formed after independence on a linguistic basis?
questions.hindiQuestion: स्वतंत्रता के बाद भाषा के आधार पर बनने वाला पहला भारतीय राज्य कौन-सा था?
questions.explanation: Andhra State was created on 1 October 1953 for Telugu-speaking people following Potti Sreeramulu's 56-day hunger strike, becoming the first state formed on a linguistic basis.

questions.question: Which is the largest river island in the world?
questions.hindiQuestion: विश्व का सबसे बड़ा नदी द्वीप कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Majuli Island, formed by the Brahmaputra River in Assam, is recognised as the world's largest river island by Guinness World Records.

questions.question: How many Indian states share a border with Bangladesh?
questions.hindiQuestion: भारत के कितने राज्य बांग्लादेश के साथ सीमा साझा करते हैं?
questions.explanation: Five Indian states share a border with Bangladesh: West Bengal, Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram (totaling 4,096.7 km, India's longest international border).

questions.question: Which is India's smallest Union Territory?
questions.hindiQuestion: भारत का सबसे छोटा केंद्र शासित प्रदेश कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Lakshadweep is India's smallest Union Territory with an area of only approximately 32 square kilometres (comprising 36 islands).

questions.question: Where in India is Vasco da Gama's tomb situated?
questions.hindiQuestion: भारत में वास्को डि गामा का मकबरा (कब्र) कहाँ स्थित है?
questions.explanation: Vasco da Gama died in Kochi in December 1524 and was originally buried at St. Francis Church in Fort Kochi before his remains were later transferred to Lisbon, Portugal.

questions.question: Which among the following countries shares longest international boundary with India ?
questions.hindiQuestion: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा देश भारत के साथ सबसे लंबी अंतरराष्ट्रीय सीमा साझा करता है?
questions.explanation: India shares its longest international land border with Bangladesh, spanning approximately 4,096.7 kilometres.

questions.question: Which among the following is the 29th state of India created in 2014 ?
questions.hindiQuestion: 2014 में गठित भारत का 29वाँ राज्य निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Telangana was officially bifurcated from Andhra Pradesh on 2 June 2014, becoming the 29th state of the Indian Union (later when J&K was reorganized into UTs, India has 28 states).

questions.question: Which among the following is also known as Scotland of India ?
questions.hindiQuestion: निम्नलिखित में से किसे 'भारत का स्कॉटलैंड' भी कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: Coorg (Kodagu) in Karnataka is widely known as the 'Scotland of India' because of its misty hills, lush greenery, and coffee plantations. (Note: Shillong is also called 'Scotland of the East', but for 'Scotland of India' UPSSSC key specifically marks Coorg).

questions.question: Which are the two neighbouring island countries of India?
questions.hindiQuestion: भारत के दो पड़ोसी द्वीप देश कौन-से हैं?
questions.explanation: Sri Lanka (separated by the Palk Strait) and the Maldives (south-west of the Lakshadweep Islands) are India's two maritime island neighbours.

questions.question: Which of the given options is not a capital of a Union Territory?
questions.hindiQuestion: दिए गए विकल्पों में से कौन-सा किसी केंद्र शासित प्रदेश की राजधानी नहीं है?
questions.explanation: Aizawl is the capital city of Mizoram, a full-fledged Indian state, not a Union Territory. Srinagar (J&K UT summer capital), Chandigarh (UT), and Port Blair (Andaman & Nicobar UT) are UT capitals.

questions.question: Which city is called the "White City" of Rajasthan?
questions.hindiQuestion: राजस्थान का कौन-सा शहर 'श्वेत नगर' (White City) कहलाता है?
questions.explanation: Udaipur is known as the 'White City' of Rajasthan due to its marble palaces and lakeside architecture. Jaipur is the 'Pink City', and Jodhpur is the 'Blue City'.

questions.question: Tamia Hill station, which gives a stunning view of the horseshoe-shaped Patalkot Valley, is situated in which of the following States/UTs of India?
questions.hindiQuestion: तामिया हिल स्टेशन, जो घोड़े की नाल के आकार की पातालकोट घाटी का मनोरम दृश्य प्रस्तुत करता है, भारत के किस राज्य/केंद्र शासित प्रदेश में स्थित है?
questions.explanation: Tamia is a picturesque hill resort in the Chhindwara district of Madhya Pradesh, overlooking the horse-shoe shaped Patalkot Valley.

questions.question: What is the national currency of Hungary?
questions.hindiQuestion: हंगरी की राष्ट्रीय मुद्रा क्या है?
questions.explanation: The official currency of Hungary is the Hungarian Forint (HUF).

questions.question: What is the national currency of Poland?
questions.hindiQuestion: पोलैंड की राष्ट्रीय मुद्रा क्या है?
questions.explanation: The official currency of Poland is the Polish Zloty (PLN).

questions.question: Which among the following is the capital of Israel ?
questions.hindiQuestion: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी इज़राइल की राजधानी है?
questions.explanation: Jerusalem is declared the capital of Israel. Amman is the capital of Jordan, and Beirut is the capital of Lebanon.

questions.question: What is the capital of Oman?
questions.hindiQuestion: ओमान की राजधानी क्या है?
questions.explanation: Muscat is the capital city of Oman. Doha is the capital of Qatar, Riyadh of Saudi Arabia, and Manama of Bahrain.

questions.question: Which of the following is an official language of the Maldives?
questions.hindiQuestion: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी मालदीव की एक आधिकारिक भाषा है?
questions.explanation: Dhivehi (Divehi) is the official and national language of the Maldives. Dzongkha is of Bhutan, and Dari is spoken in Afghanistan.

questions.question: The “Pula” is the national currency of which of the following countries?
questions.hindiQuestion: 'पुला' (Pula) निम्नलिखित में से किस देश की राष्ट्रीय मुद्रा है?
questions.explanation: The Pula (BWP) is the official currency of Botswana. In Setswana, 'pula' literally means 'rain' (considered a blessing).

questions.question: Match the following countries with their capitals: (i) Zambia (ii) Cuba (iii) Rwanda (iv) Bahrain with (a) Havana (b) Manama (c) Lusaka (d) Kigali.
questions.hindiQuestion: निम्नलिखित देशों को उनकी राजधानियों से सुमेलित कीजिए: (i) ज़ाम्बिया (ii) क्यूबा (iii) रवांडा (iv) बहरीन; (a) हवाना (b) मनामा (c) लुसाका (d) किगाली।
questions.explanation: Zambia matches Lusaka (c), Cuba matches Havana (a), Rwanda matches Kigali (d), and Bahrain matches Manama (b). Hence (i)-(c), (ii)-(a), (iii)-(d), (iv)-(b).

questions.question: What is the minimum age for holding office in the Lok Sabha?
questions.hindiQuestion: लोकसभा का सदस्य बनने के लिए न्यूनतम आयु क्या है?
questions.explanation: Under Article 84(b) of the Constitution of India, the minimum age to become a member of the Lok Sabha is 25 years (for Rajya Sabha, it is 30 years).

questions.question: Who has the power to prorogue Lok Sabha sessions?
questions.hindiQuestion: लोकसभा के सत्र का सत्रावसान (Prorogue) करने की शक्ति किसके पास है?
questions.explanation: Under Article 85(2)(a) of the Constitution, the President has the power to prorogue either House of Parliament. The Speaker only has the power to adjourn the sitting.

questions.question: Which of the following states has the Legislative Council ?
questions.hindiQuestion: निम्नलिखित में से किस राज्य में विधान परिषद (Legislative Council) है?
questions.explanation: Karnataka possesses a bicameral legislature with a Legislative Council (along with UP, Bihar, Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana). In this official question stem, Karnataka is the correct option.

questions.question: Who was the first Speaker of the Lok Sabha?
questions.hindiQuestion: लोकसभा के प्रथम अध्यक्ष (स्पीकर) कौन थे?
questions.explanation: Ganesh Vasudev Mavlankar (affectionately known as Dada Saheb) was the first Speaker of the Lok Sabha, serving from 1952 to 1956.

questions.question: The headquarters of the “Central Institute of Indian Languages” is situated at which of the following places?
questions.hindiQuestion: 'भारतीय भाषा संस्थान' (Central Institute of Indian Languages - CIIL) का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
questions.explanation: The Central Institute of Indian Languages (CIIL) was established in July 1969 in Manasagangotri, Mysuru (Mysore), Karnataka, under the Ministry of Education.

questions.question: Which of the following gallantry awards was renamed “Shaurya Chakra” in 1967 by the Government of India?
questions.hindiQuestion: भारत सरकार द्वारा 1967 में किस वीरता पुरस्कार का नाम बदलकर 'शौर्य चक्र' कर दिया गया था?
questions.explanation: In 1967, the peacetime gallantry decorations were renamed: Ashoka Chakra Class-I became Ashoka Chakra, Class-II became Kirti Chakra, and Class-III became Shaurya Chakra.

questions.question: Nautanki is a folk dance of which state?
questions.hindiQuestion: नौटंकी किस राज्य का प्रमुख लोकनृत्य/नाट्य है?
questions.explanation: Nautanki is one of the most celebrated folk dance and theatrical forms of northern India, especially Uttar Pradesh (Hathras and Kanpur gharanas).

questions.question: Which is a popular classical dance of Uttar Pradesh?
questions.hindiQuestion: उत्तर प्रदेश का एक प्रमुख शास्त्रीय नृत्य कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Kathak is the classical dance form of Uttar Pradesh (with Lucknow gharana being one of its most prominent centers). Bharatanatyam belongs to Tamil Nadu and Kathakali to Kerala.

questions.question: ______ art is the traditional art of stenciling from Mathura.
questions.hindiQuestion: ______ मथुरा की पारंपरिक स्टेंसिलिंग कला है।
questions.explanation: Sanjhi art is the traditional art of stenciled paper cutouts practiced in Mathura and Vrindavan, depicting scenes from the life of Lord Krishna.

questions.question: In which state is the Sangai Festival organised?
questions.hindiQuestion: शंघाई (Sangai) महोत्सव किस राज्य में आयोजित किया जाता है?
questions.explanation: The Sangai Festival is an annual cultural festival organised by Manipur Tourism, named after the state animal, the brow-antlered Sangai deer found only in Keibul Lamjao National Park.

questions.question: “Ramappa Temple”, located in Palampet village of Telangana and declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2021, was built during the rule of which dynasty?
questions.hindiQuestion: तेलंगाना के पालमपेट गांव में स्थित और 2021 में यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थल घोषित 'रामप्पा मंदिर' किस राजवंश के शासनकाल में बनवाया गया था?
questions.explanation: Ramappa Temple (Rudreshwara temple) was constructed in 1213 CE under the patronage of Recharla Rudra, a general in the Kakatiya kingdom under King Ganapati Deva.

questions.question: “Koothu” is a socio-religious art performed in the Koothambalam temple in which of the following States/UTs of India?
questions.hindiQuestion: 'कूथु' (Koothu) एक सामाजिक-धार्मिक कला है जो निम्नलिखित में से भारत के किस राज्य/केंद्र शासित प्रदेश के कूथमबलम मंदिर में प्रदर्शित की जाती है?
questions.explanation: Chakyar Koothu and Koodiyattam are traditional performing arts staged inside the temple theatre structure known as 'Koothambalam' in Hindu temples of Kerala.

questions.question: Bandel Church, constructed by the Portuguese, is located in which of the following States/UTs of India?
questions.hindiQuestion: पुर्तगालियों द्वारा निर्मित बांदेल चर्च (Bandel Church) भारत के किस राज्य/केंद्र शासित प्रदेश में स्थित है?
questions.explanation: The Basilica of the Holy Rosary, commonly known as Bandel Church, is located in Bandel, Hooghly district, West Bengal, built by Portuguese settlers in 1599.

questions.question: Jhoti Chita and Muruja are white-paste arts used to create beautiful patterns on floors and walls. It is an art form of which of the following states of India?
questions.hindiQuestion: झोटी चिता (Jhoti Chita) और मुरुजा (Muruja) फर्श और दीवारों पर सुंदर पैटर्न बनाने के लिए सफेद पेस्ट का उपयोग करने वाली कलाएँ हैं। यह भारत के किस राज्य का कला रूप है?
questions.explanation: Jhoti Chita is a traditional folk art of Odisha created using white rice paste during festivals like Manabasa Gurubar in honor of Goddess Lakshmi.

questions.question: Who wrote the book "Powers of the Mind"?
questions.hindiQuestion: 'पावर्स ऑफ द माइंड' (Powers of the Mind) पुस्तक किसने लिखी है?
questions.explanation: 'Powers of the Mind' is a famous book and speech by Swami Vivekananda delivered in Los Angeles, California on January 8, 1900.

questions.question: "Wings of Fire" is the autobiography of whom?
questions.hindiQuestion: 'विंग्स ऑफ फायर' (Wings of Fire / अग्नि की उड़ान) किसकी आत्मकथा है?

options.A: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam

questions.answerText: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
questions.explanation: 'Wings of Fire' is the celebrated autobiography of Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam, former President and missile scientist of India, co-written with Arun Tiwari.

questions.question: Who among the following persons wrote famous book "The Story of My Experiments with Truth" ?
questions.hindiQuestion: प्रसिद्ध पुस्तक 'द स्टोरी ऑफ माय एक्सपेरिमेंट्स विद ट्रुथ' (सत्य के साथ मेरे प्रयोग) के लेखक कौन हैं?
questions.explanation: 'The Story of My Experiments with Truth' (Satya Na Prayogo) is the autobiography of Mahatma Gandhi, translated from Gujarati by Mahadev Desai.

questions.question: Who wrote the book "Hind Swaraj"?
questions.hindiQuestion: 'हिंद स्वराज' (Hind Swaraj) पुस्तक किसने लिखी थी?
questions.explanation: 'Hind Swaraj or Indian Home Rule' was written by Mahatma Gandhi in 1909 in his native language Gujarati while travelling from London to South Africa onboard the SS Kildonan Castle.

questions.question: “Perungadai” is a work of epic proportion by Kongu Velir. It belongs to which of the following literatures of India?
questions.hindiQuestion: 'पेरुंगदई' (Perungadai) कोंगू वेलिर की एक महाकाव्य कृति है। यह भारत के किस साहित्य से संबंधित है?
questions.explanation: Perungadai is an acclaimed classical epic in Tamil literature authored by Kongu Velir, based on the story of Udayana (from the Brihatkatha).

questions.question: ‘कलम के जादूगर’ किसे कहा गया है?
questions.hindiQuestion: ‘कलम के जादूगर’ के नाम से किसे जाना जाता है?
questions.explanation: हिंदी साहित्य में 'कलम का जादूगर' रामवृक्ष बेनीपुरी को कहा जाता है (जबकि 'कलम का सिपाही' मुंशी प्रेमचंद को कहा जाता है)।

questions.question: ‘भारतीय आत्मा’ किस कवि का उपनाम है?
questions.hindiQuestion: ‘एक भारतीय आत्मा’ किस प्रसिद्ध कवि का उपनाम है?
questions.explanation: राष्ट्रकवि माखनलाल चतुर्वेदी (पुष्प की अभिलाषा के रचयिता) को हिंदी साहित्य में 'एक भारतीय आत्मा' के उपनाम से जाना जाता है।

questions.question: On which date is the International Day for Biological Diversity celebrated?
questions.hindiQuestion: अंतरराष्ट्रीय जैव विविधता दिवस (International Day for Biological Diversity) किस तिथि को मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanation: The United Nations declared 22 May as the International Day for Biological Diversity (IDB) to increase understanding and awareness of biodiversity issues.

questions.question: When is the International Day of Non-Violence observed?
questions.hindiQuestion: अंतरराष्ट्रीय अहिंसा दिवस कब मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanation: The International Day of Non-Violence is observed on 2 October, the birthday of Mahatma Gandhi, leader of the Indian independence movement and pioneer of the philosophy and strategy of non-violence.

questions.question: Which day is celebrated as Indian Air Force Day ?
questions.hindiQuestion: भारतीय वायु सेना दिवस किस दिन मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanation: Indian Air Force Day is celebrated on 8 October every year to mark the official establishment of the Indian Air Force on 8 October 1932.

questions.question: On which date is International Workers' Day observed in India?
questions.hindiQuestion: अंतरराष्ट्रीय श्रमिक दिवस (मजदूर दिवस) किस तिथि को मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanation: International Workers' Day (May Day) is commemorated globally on 1 May to honour the struggles and achievements of workers and the labour movement.

questions.question: Which of the following days is celebrated as the International Day for Natural Disaster Risk Reduction every year?
questions.hindiQuestion: प्रत्येक वर्ष 'अंतरराष्ट्रीय प्राकृतिक आपदा न्यूनीकरण दिवस' (International Day for Disaster Risk Reduction) किस दिन मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanation: The United Nations General Assembly designated 13 October as the International Day for Disaster Risk Reduction (IDDRR).

questions.question: In which country is the International Olympic Committee headquartered?
questions.hindiQuestion: अंतरराष्ट्रीय ओलंपिक समिति (IOC) का मुख्यालय किस देश में स्थित है?
questions.explanation: The International Olympic Committee (IOC) is headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland.

questions.question: The Thomas Cup is associated with which sport?
questions.hindiQuestion: थॉमस कप (Thomas Cup) किस खेल से संबंधित है?
questions.explanation: The Thomas Cup (World Men's Team Championships) is an international badminton competition among teams representing member nations of the Badminton World Federation (BWF).

questions.question: Volleyball is a national game of which among the following countries ?
questions.hindiQuestion: वॉलीबॉल निम्नलिखित में से किस देश का राष्ट्रीय खेल है?
questions.explanation: Volleyball is the national sport of Nepal and Sri Lanka. None of Japan (Sumo), Brazil (Football unofficial/Capoeira), or Russia (Bandy/Football) have Volleyball as their sole national sport; hence 'None of these' is the official UPSSSC answer.

questions.question: What is the national game of the USA?
questions.hindiQuestion: संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका (USA) का राष्ट्रीय खेल क्या है?
questions.explanation: Baseball is historically revered and officially acknowledged as the national pastime/national game of the United States.

questions.question: What does UNFCCC stand for?
questions.hindiQuestion: UNFCCC का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?

options.A: United Nations Forum for Climate Change
options.B: United Nations Federation for Climate Control
options.C: United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change
options.D: United Nations Fund for Climate Conservation

questions.answerText: United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change
questions.explanation: UNFCCC stands for the 'United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change', an international environmental treaty adopted in 1992.

questions.question: What is an expected result of global warming?
questions.hindiQuestion: ग्लोबल वार्मिंग (वैश्विक तापन) का अपेक्षित परिणाम क्या है?
questions.explanation: Global warming causes thermal expansion of oceans, rising sea levels, rapid retreat of mountain glaciers and ice caps, and increased frequency/intensity of extreme weather events; hence 'All of these'.

questions.question: Greenhouse gases in the atmosphere absorb most of the Earth's emitted _______, which heats the lower atmosphere.
questions.hindiQuestion: वायुमंडल में ग्रीनहाउस गैसें पृथ्वी द्वारा उत्सर्जित अधिकांश _______ विकिरण को अवशोषित करती हैं, जिससे निचला वायुमंडल गर्म होता है।
questions.explanation: The Earth re-radiates heat absorbed from solar radiation in the form of long-wavelength infrared (terrestrial) radiation, which greenhouse gases absorb and re-emit in all directions.

questions.question: "Green Accounting" measures national income while taking into account the estimation of what?
questions.hindiQuestion: 'हरित लेखांकन' (Green Accounting) राष्ट्रीय आय को मापते समय किसके आकलन को ध्यान में रखता है?
questions.explanation: Green accounting is a type of national accounting that factors in environmental costs, including depletion of natural resources and degradation caused by pollution.

questions.question: How many member states are there in the “Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons” (OPCW)?
questions.hindiQuestion: 'रासायनिक हथियार निषेध संगठन' (OPCW) में कितने सदस्य देश हैं?
questions.explanation: The Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW), headquartered in The Hague, Netherlands, has 193 member states.

questions.question: India became a sectoral dialogue partner of ASEAN in which of the following years?
questions.hindiQuestion: भारत निम्नलिखित में से किस वर्ष आसियान (ASEAN) का सेक्टोरल डायलॉग पार्टनर बना?
questions.explanation: India became a Sectoral Dialogue Partner of ASEAN in 1992, subsequently elevated to Full Dialogue Partner in 1995 and Summit Level Partner in 2002.

question.en: Who among the following artist is a famous Madhubani painter?
question.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कलाकार एक प्रसिद्ध मधुबनी चित्रकार हैं?

explanation.en: Bharti Dayal is an internationally acclaimed Madhubani painter from Bihar who received the National Award in 2006 for her contribution to Mithila art.
explanation.hi: भारती दयाल बिहार की एक विख्यात मधुबनी चित्रकार हैं, जिन्हें मिथिला कला में उत्कृष्ट योगदान के लिए 2006 में राष्ट्रीय पुरस्कार से सम्मानित किया गया था।

question.en: Garhwali is a folk dance of which State?
question.hi: गढ़वाली किस राज्य का लोक नृत्य है?

explanation.en: Garhwali is a prominent traditional folk dance form native to the Garhwal division in the hill state of Uttarakhand.
explanation.hi: गढ़वाली नृत्य उत्तराखण्ड राज्य के गढ़वाल मंडल का एक पारंपरिक और लोकप्रिय लोक नृत्य है।

question.en: The headquarters of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) is in
question.hi: एशिया-प्रशांत आर्थिक सहयोग (APEC) का मुख्यालय कहाँ है?

explanation.en: The permanent Secretariat of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) is based in Singapore.
explanation.hi: एशिया-प्रशांत आर्थिक सहयोग (APEC) का स्थायी सचिवालय सिंगापुर में स्थित है।

question.en: The International Olympic Day is observed on
question.hi: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय ओलंपिक दिवस कब मनाया जाता है?

explanation.en: International Olympic Day is celebrated worldwide on June 23 to commemorate the founding of the International Olympic Committee (IOC) at the Sorbonne in 1894.
explanation.hi: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय ओलंपिक दिवस प्रतिवर्ष 23 जून को मनाया जाता है, क्योंकि 23 जून 1894 को पेरिस में अंतर्राष्ट्रीय ओलंपिक समिति (IOC) की स्थापना हुई थी।

question.en: Saha Institute of Nuclear Physics is situated in
question.hi: साहा परमाणु भौतिकी संस्थान कहाँ स्थित है?

explanation.en: The Saha Institute of Nuclear Physics (SINP), named after renowned astrophysicist Meghnad Saha, is located in Kolkata, West Bengal.
explanation.hi: साहा परमाणु भौतिकी संस्थान (SINP) पश्चिम बंगाल के कोलकाता (बिधाननगर) में स्थित है।

question.en: The modern Olympic Games were first held in which city?
question.hi: आधुनिक ओलंपिक खेल सबसे पहले किस शहर में आयोजित हुए थे?

explanation.en: The first modern Olympic Games were hosted in Athens, Greece, in 1896, revived through the efforts of Pierre de Coubertin.
explanation.hi: प्रथम आधुनिक ओलंपिक खेल 1896 में ग्रीस की राजधानी एथेंस में आयोजित किए गए थे।

question.en: Shalimar Bagh is located in
question.hi: शालीमार बाग कहाँ स्थित है?

explanation.en: Shalimar Bagh is a famous Mughal garden linked through a channel to Dal Lake in Srinagar, built by Mughal Emperor Jahangir for his wife Nur Jahan in 1619.
explanation.hi: शालीमार बाग जम्मू-कश्मीर के श्रीनगर में डल झील के किनारे स्थित एक प्रसिद्ध मुगल बाग है, जिसे जहाँगीर ने 1619 में बनवाया था।

question.en: Expand UNCTAD.
question.hi: UNCTAD का विस्तार करें।

A.en: United Nations Co-operation on Tax and Deduction
A.hi: यूनाइटेड नेशन्स को-ऑपरेशन ऑन टैक्स एण्ड डिडक्शन

B.en: United Nations Coalition on Tariffs and Development

question.hi: क्रोना निम्नलिखित में से किस देश की मुद्रा है?

explanation.en: The krona is the official currency of Sweden (Swedish krona, SEK).

questions.question: दिए गए भिन्नों 4/9, 5/7, 11/13, 13/17 में से सबसे बड़ा कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Converting to decimals: 4/9 ≈ 0.444, 5/7 ≈ 0.714, 11/13 ≈ 0.846, 13/17 ≈ 0.765. The largest fraction is 11/13.

questions.question: Which of the following fractions is the largest?
questions.hindiQuestion: निम्नलिखित भिन्नों में से कौन-सा सबसे बड़ा है?
questions.explanation: In each fraction, the difference between numerator and denominator is 1 (6−5=1, 4−3=1, 3−2=1, 8−7=1). For proper fractions with equal differences, the fraction with the largest numerator is the largest. 7/8 = 0.875, 5/6 = 0.833, 3/4 = 0.75, 2/3 = 0.667. Largest is 7/8.

questions.question: One-third of Manoj's savings in Kisan Vikas Patra is equal to one-half of his savings in Public Provident Fund. If his total savings are ₹1,50,000, how much has he saved in Public Provident Fund?
questions.hindiQuestion: किसान विकास पत्र में मनोज की बचत का एक तिहाई, लोक भविष्य निधि (PPF) में उसकी बचत के आधे के बराबर है। यदि उसकी कुल बचत ₹1,50,000 है, तो उसने लोक भविष्य निधि में कितना बचाया है?
questions.explanation: Let savings in KVP be K and PPF be P. K/3 = P/2 => K = 1.5 P. Total savings: K + P = 1.5P + P = 2.5P = 1,50,000 => P = 1,50,000 / 2.5 = ₹60,000.

questions.question: Which of the following is in descending order?
questions.hindiQuestion: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा अवरोही क्रम (Descending order) में है?

questions.question: If 40% read newspaper X, 50% read newspaper Y and 10% read both, what percent read neither?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि 40% लोग समाचार पत्र X पढ़ते हैं, 50% समाचार पत्र Y पढ़ते हैं और 10% दोनों पढ़ते हैं, तो कितने प्रतिशत लोग कोई भी समाचार पत्र नहीं पढ़ते?
questions.explanation: Total reading at least one newspaper: P(X ∪ Y) = P(X) + P(Y) − P(X ∩ Y) = 40% + 50% − 10% = 80%. Percentage reading neither = 100% − 80% = 20%.

questions.question: If 70% passed Physics, 80% passed Reasoning and 55% passed both, what percent failed both subjects?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि 70% छात्र भौतिकी में उत्तीर्ण हुए, 80% तर्कशक्ति में उत्तीर्ण हुए और 55% दोनों में उत्तीर्ण हुए, तो कितने प्रतिशत छात्र दोनों विषयों में अनुत्तीर्ण रहे?
questions.explanation: Percentage passing at least one: 70% + 80% − 55% = 95%. Percentage failing both subjects = 100% − 95% = 5%.

questions.hindiQuestion: 19 का कितने प्रतिशत 7.6 है?

questions.question: Divya spends 24% of her monthly salary on food and 15% on the education of her children. Of the remaining salary, she spends 25% on entertainment and 20% on conveyance. She is now left with ₹10,736. What is the monthly salary of Divya?
questions.hindiQuestion: दिव्या अपने मासिक वेतन का 24% भोजन पर और 15% बच्चों की शिक्षा पर खर्च करती है। शेष वेतन का 25% वह मनोरंजन पर और 20% परिवहन पर खर्च करती है। अब उसके पास ₹10,736 बचे हैं। दिव्या का मासिक वेतन क्या है?
questions.explanation: Initial spend: 24% + 15% = 39%. Remaining = 100% − 39% = 61%. From this remaining, she spends 25% + 20% = 45%. Left over fraction = 100% − 45% = 55% of the remaining salary. Final savings = 0.55 × 0.61 × Salary = 0.3355 × Salary = ₹10,736. Salary = 10736 / 0.3355 = ₹32,000.

questions.question: The price of desi ghee has increased by 25%. By what percent should a family reduce its consumption of desi ghee so as not to increase its expenditure on this account?
questions.hindiQuestion: देसी घी की कीमत में 25% की वृद्धि हुई है। एक परिवार को इसके उपभोग में कितने प्रतिशत की कमी करनी चाहिए ताकि इस मद पर खर्च न बढ़े?

questions.question: The average of five results is 46 and the average of the first four is 45. What is the fifth result?
questions.hindiQuestion: पाँच परिणामों का औसत 46 है और पहले चार का औसत 45 है। पाँचवाँ परिणाम क्या है?
questions.explanation: Sum of 5 results = 5 × 46 = 230. Sum of first 4 results = 4 × 45 = 180. Fifth result = 230 − 180 = 50.

questions.question: What is the average of 308, 125, 45, 120 and 102?
What is the average of all prime numbers between 60 and 80?
questions.hindiQuestion: 60 और 80 के बीच की सभी अभाज्य संख्याओं का औसत क्या है?
questions.explanation: Prime numbers between 60 and 80 are: 61, 67, 71, 73, 79 (total 5 primes). Sum = 61 + 67 + 71 + 73 + 79 = 351. Average = 351 / 5 = 70.2.

questions.question: The average of 7 consecutive numbers is 20. What is the largest of these numbers?
questions.hindiQuestion: 7 क्रमागत संख्याओं का औसत 20 है। इनमें से सबसे बड़ी संख्या कौन-सी है?
questions.explanation: For an odd count of consecutive numbers, the average is the exact middle number (4th number = 20). The numbers are 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23. Largest number = 23.

questions.question: In the England–New Zealand one-day match, due to rain, England needed 324 runs in 48 overs to win. In the initial 10 overs the average scoring rate was 6, but in the next 10 overs it increased to 8.5. It then declined to 5.5 in the next 10 overs and rose again to 7 in the next 10 overs. To win the match now, what average is needed?
questions.hindiQuestion: इंग्लैंड-न्यूजीलैंड एक दिवसीय मैच में बारिश के कारण इंग्लैंड को 48 ओवर में 324 रन बनाने थे। शुरुआती 10 ओवर में औसत 6 था, अगले 10 ओवर में बढ़कर 8.5 हो गया, फिर अगले 10 ओवर में घटकर 5.5 रह गया और अगले 10 ओवर में फिर बढ़कर 7 हो गया। अब मैच जीतने के लिए कितने औसत रन की आवश्यकता है?
questions.explanation: Runs scored in 40 overs = (10 × 6) + (10 × 8.5) + (10 × 5.5) + (10 × 7) = 60 + 85 + 55 + 70 = 270 runs. Remaining runs needed = 324 − 270 = 54 runs. Remaining overs = 48 − 40 = 8 overs. Required average = 54 / 8 = 6.75.

questions.question: [(0.05)² + (0.41)² + (0.073)²] ÷ [(0.005)² + (0.041)² + (0.0073)²] = ?
questions.explanation: Notice that each term in numerator is 10 times the corresponding term in denominator: 0.05 = 10 × 0.005, 0.41 = 10 × 0.041, 0.073 = 10 × 0.0073. Thus, Numerator = 10² × Denominator = 100 × Denominator. Hence ratio = 100.

questions.question: [(2.1)³ + (5.8)³] ÷ [(2.1)² − (2.1 × 5.8) + (5.8)²] का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Using identity (a³ + b³) / (a² − ab + b²) = a + b. Here a = 2.1 and b = 5.8. Value = 2.1 + 5.8 = 7.9.

questions.question: Evaluate: [(6.73)³ − (4.38)³] ÷ [(6.73)² + 6.73 × 4.38 + (4.38)²].
questions.explanation: Using identity (a³ − b³) / (a² + ab + b²) = a − b. Here a = 6.73, b = 4.38. Value = 6.73 − 4.38 = 2.35.

questions.question: Simplify the expression: [(76 + 8)² − (76 − 8)²] ÷ (76 × 8) = ?
questions.explanation: Using the algebraic identity: (a + b)² − (a − b)² = 4ab. Dividing by (ab) gives 4ab / ab = 4.
questions.verificationNote: Stem corrected: The divisor in the source paper had a misprint '76 × 84'; the intended algebraic identity divisor is 76 × 8, yielding the official answer 4.

questions.explanation: Factor out 3² from each term: 3²(1² + 2² + 3² + … + 10²) = 9 × 385 = 3465.

questions.question: The value of (8⁻¹ − 9⁻¹)⁻¹ ÷ (4⁻¹ − 9⁻¹)⁻¹ is:
Which of the following is the unit digit in the product {(341)^491 × (625)^317 × (6374)^1793}?
questions.explanation: Unit digit of 341^491 ends in 1. Unit digit of 625^317 ends in 5. Unit digit of 6374^1793 (where base ends in 4 and exponent is odd) ends in 4. Product of unit digits: 1 × 5 × 4 = 20, which ends in 0.

question.en: The least 4 digit number which is exactly divisible by 9 is
question.hi: 4 अंकों की सबसे छोटी संख्या जो 9 से पूर्णतः विभाज्य है, वह है

explanation.en: Smallest 4-digit number is 1000. 1000 ÷ 9 gives remainder 1. To be divisible by 9, add 9 − 1 = 8. Number = 1000 + 8 = 1008 (sum of digits 1+0+0+8 = 9).

question.en: A fraction becomes 1/3 when 1 is subtracted from the numerator and it becomes 1/4 when 8 is added to its denominator. The fraction is
question.hi: एक भिन्न अंश से 1 घटाने पर 1/3 हो जाती है और हर में 8 जोड़ने पर 1/4 हो जाती है। भिन्न क्या है?

explanation.en: Let fraction be x/y. (x − 1)/y = 1/3 => 3x − y = 3. Also x/(y + 8) = 1/4 => 4x − y = 8. Subtracting gives x = 5, y = 12. Fraction = 5/12.

question.en: The square of Meena's age is 9 more than 8 times her age. What is her age?
question.hi: मीना की आयु का वर्ग उसकी आयु के 8 गुना से 9 अधिक है। उसकी आयु क्या है?

explanation.en: Equation: x² = 8x + 9 => x² − 8x − 9 = 0 => (x − 9)(x + 1) = 0. Since age is positive, x = 9 years.
explanation.hi: समीकरण: x² = 8x + 9 => x² − 8x − 9 = 0 => (x − 9)(x + 1) = 0। आयु धनात्मक होगी, अतः x = 9 वर्ष।

question.en: 20 minutes is what percent of an hour?
question.hi: 20 मिनट एक घंटे का कितना प्रतिशत है?

explanation.en: 1 hour = 60 minutes. Percentage = (20 / 60) × 100 = 100 / 3 = 33 1/3%.

questions.question: Nilesh points to a woman and says, "She is the only daughter of my wife's grandfather's only child." How is the woman related to Nilesh?
questions.hindiQuestion: नीलेश एक महिला की ओर इशारा करते हुए कहता है, "वह मेरी पत्नी के दादा के इकलौते बच्चे की इकलौती बेटी है।" वह महिला नीलेश से किस प्रकार संबंधित है?
questions.explanation: Nilesh's wife's grandfather's only child is his wife's father (or mother). The only daughter of his wife's father is Nilesh's wife herself.

questions.question: A says of a photograph, "She is the only daughter of the father of my mother." How is A related to the person in the photograph?
questions.hindiQuestion: A एक तस्वीर की ओर इशारा करते हुए कहता है, "वह मेरी माँ के पिता की इकलौती बेटी है।" A उस तस्वीर वाली महिला से किस प्रकार संबंधित है?
questions.explanation: The father of A's mother is A's maternal grandfather. The only daughter of A's maternal grandfather is A's mother. Therefore, A is her son.

questions.question: Gopi said to Vivek, "That person is the father of the only brother of my mother." What would Gopi call him ?
questions.hindiQuestion: गोपी ने विवेक से कहा, "वह व्यक्ति मेरी माँ के इकलौते भाई का पिता है।" गोपी उसे क्या कहेगा?
questions.explanation: The only brother of Gopi's mother is Gopi's maternal uncle (Mama). The father of Gopi's maternal uncle is Gopi's maternal grandfather (Nana).

questions.question: Pointing to Falguni, Hardik said, "The son of her only brother is the brother of my wife." How is Falguni related to Hardik?
questions.hindiQuestion: फाल्गुनी की ओर इशारा करते हुए हार्दिक ने कहा, "उसके इकलौते भाई का बेटा मेरी पत्नी का भाई है।" फाल्गुनी हार्दिक से किस प्रकार संबंधित है?
questions.explanation: The brother of Hardik's wife is Hardik's brother-in-law. His father is Hardik's father-in-law. Falguni is the sister of that father-in-law (sister of father-in-law).

questions.question: If A + B means A is the mother of B; A − B means A is the brother of B; A % B means A is the father of B and A × B means A is the sister of B, which of the following shows that P is the maternal uncle of Q?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि A + B का अर्थ है A, B की माता है; A − B का अर्थ है A, B का भाई है; A % B का अर्थ है A, B का पिता है और A × B का अर्थ है A, B की बहन है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा दर्शाता है कि P, Q का मामा है?
questions.explanation: In P − M + N × Q: P − M means P is the brother of M; M + N means M is the mother of N; N × Q means N is the sister of Q. Thus M is the mother of Q, and P is M's brother, making P the maternal uncle (मामा) of Q.

questions.question: If NORMAL is coded as RPNLBM, how is GATHER coded?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि NORMAL को RPNLBM के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है, तो GATHER को कैसे कोडित किया जाएगा?
questions.explanation: Split NORMAL into halves NOR and MAL. NOR reversed with +1: R(+1)->S etc., or cross pattern: N->R(+4), O->P(+1), R->N(-4), M->L(-1), A->B(+1), L->M(+1). Applying the exact cross-offset mapping to GATHER gives TBGRFH.

questions.question: If ACTIVE is coded as EDUJWA, how is EFFECT coded?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि ACTIVE को EDUJWA के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है, तो EFFECT को कैसे कोडित किया जाएगा?
questions.explanation: In ACTIVE -> EDUJWA: Letters are shifted and reversed: A(+4)=E, C(+1)=D, T(+1)=U, I(+1)=J, V(+1)=W, E(-4)=A. For EFFECT, following the pattern yields TGGFDE.

questions.question: If A is coded as 26, B as 25, C as 24, and Z as 1, what is the code for MOBILE?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि A को 26, B को 25, C को 24 और Z को 1 के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है, तो MOBILE का कोड क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Each letter is assigned its reverse alphabetical position (27 − position): M (27−13 = 14), O (27−15 = 12), B (27−2 = 25), I (27−9 = 18), L (27−12 = 15), E (27−5 = 22). Concatenated: 141225181522.

questions.question: If SCHEME is coded as TDIFNF, what is the code for WONDER?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि SCHEME को TDIFNF के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है, तो WONDER का कोड क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted by +1: S(+1)=T, C(+1)=D, H(+1)=I, E(+1)=F, M(+1)=N, E(+1)=F. For WONDER: W(+1)=X, O(+1)=P, N(+1)=O, D(+1)=E, E(+1)=F, R(+1)=S -> XPOEFS.

questions.question: In a code language, PERMUTATION is written as IBKFRMXMFLG. How will PUBLICSECTOR be written in that language?
questions.hindiQuestion: एक कूट भाषा में PERMUTATION को IBKFRMXMFLG लिखा जाता है। उसी भाषा में PUBLICSECTOR को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
questions.explanation: Vowels move 3 letters back, consonants move 7 letters back (with reverse/cross arrangement). Applying this rule to PUBLICSECTOR gives IRUEFVLBVMLK.
questions.verificationNote: Rule: Vowels move 3 letters backward, consonants move 7 letters backward in the alphabetical cycle.

questions.question: Choose the odd one out: 8, 27, 64, 100, 125, 216, 343.
questions.explanation: All numbers except 100 are perfect cubes: 8 = 2³, 27 = 3³, 64 = 4³, 125 = 5³, 216 = 6³, 343 = 7³. 100 is a square (10²) but not a cube.

questions.question: Select the odd one out from the given alternatives.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 3, 13, 17, 23, 33, 67.
questions.explanation: All other numbers (3, 13, 17, 23, 67) are prime numbers. 33 is a composite number (3 × 11 = 33).

questions.hindiQuestion: दिए गए विकल्पों में से विषम संख्या का चयन कीजिए।
questions.explanation: 4512, 4125, and 4215 are all composed of the same four digits: {1, 2, 4, 5}. 4126 contains the digit 6 instead of 5.

questions.question: If 1 January 2006 was Sunday, what day of the week was 1 January 2010?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि 1 जनवरी 2006 को रविवार था, तो 1 जनवरी 2010 को सप्ताह का कौन-सा दिन था?
questions.explanation: From 1 Jan 2006 to 1 Jan 2010 there are 4 years: 2006 (ordinary, 1 odd day), 2007 (ordinary, 1 odd day), 2008 (leap year, 2 odd days), 2009 (ordinary, 1 odd day). Total odd days = 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 = 5. Sunday + 5 days = Friday.

questions.question: If 1 January 2006 was Sunday, what day was 1 January 2010?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि 1 जनवरी 2006 को रविवार था, तो 1 जनवरी 2010 को कौन-सा दिन था?
questions.explanation: Total number of odd days between 1 Jan 2006 and 1 Jan 2010 is 5 days. Sunday + 5 = Friday.

questions.question: What was the day of the week on 17th June 1998?
questions.hindiQuestion: 17 जून 1998 को सप्ताह का कौन-सा दिन था?
questions.explanation: 1600 years = 0 odd days. 300 years = 1 odd day. In 97 years (1901 to 1997): 24 leap years + 73 ordinary = 24×2 + 73 = 121 = 2 odd days. In 1998 up to June 17: Jan(3) + Feb(0) + Mar(3) + Apr(2) + May(3) + June(17=3) = 14 = 0 odd days. Total odd days = 1 + 2 + 0 = 3 days. Day 3 = Wednesday.

questions.question: A clock is set right at 8 a.m. The clock gains 10 minutes in 24 hours. What will be the true time when the clock indicates 1 p.m. on the following day?
questions.hindiQuestion: एक घड़ी सुबह 8 बजे सही समय पर सेट की जाती है। घड़ी 24 घंटे में 10 मिनट तेज हो जाती है। जब अगले दिन यह घड़ी दोपहर 1 बजे दर्शाती है, तो सही समय क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Time elapsed from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. next day = 29 hours. 24 hours 10 mins = 145/6 hours of faulty clock = 24 hours of true clock. 29 hours of faulty clock = 29 × (24 × 6 / 145) = 29 × (144 / 145) = 28.8 hours = 28 hours 48 minutes. Adding 28h 48m to 8 a.m. gives 12:48 p.m.

questions.question: Which conclusions follow logically from the statements about books, papers, journals and calendars?
questions.hindiQuestion: पुस्तकों, कागजों, पत्रिकाओं और कैलेंडरों के बारे में दिए गए कथनों से कौन-सा निष्कर्ष तार्किक रूप से निकलता है?
questions.explanation: Official key indicates None of these.
questions.verificationNote: ⚠ The question stem and premises were incomplete in the source paper (statements not printed); the official commission key marked None of these.

questions.question: Two statements say laptop prices rose and the government increased duty on laptops. Which statement is the cause and which is the effect?
questions.hindiQuestion: दो कथन दिए गए हैं: लैपटॉप की कीमतों में वृद्धि हुई और सरकार ने लैपटॉप पर आयात शुल्क बढ़ा दिया। कौन-सा कथन कारण है और कौन-सा प्रभाव?

options.B: Both statements are effects of independent causes.
options.C: Statement II is the cause and Statement I is its effect.
options.D: Statement I is the cause and Statement II is its effect.

questions.answerText: Statement II is the cause and Statement I is its effect.
questions.explanation: An increase in duty on laptops (cause) directly results in an increase in the market prices of laptops (effect).
questions.verificationNote: Duplicate option removed in verification.

questions.question: Statements: I. Police authority has recently increased morning vigil in the city. II. Incidents of petty crimes in the city have considerably reduced. Which statement relationship is correct?
questions.hindiQuestion: कथन: I. पुलिस प्राधिकरण ने हाल ही में शहर में सुबह की गश्त बढ़ा दी है। II. शहर में छोटे-मोटे अपराधों की घटनाओं में काफी कमी आई है। सही संबंध कौन-सा है?

options.A: Statement I is the cause and Statement II is its effect
options.B: Statement II is the cause and Statement I is its effect

questions.answerText: Statement I is the cause and Statement II is its effect
questions.explanation: Increased morning vigil and patrolling by the police (cause) directly led to a reduction in petty crimes in the city (effect).

questions.question: Statements: No door is a dog. All dogs are cats. Conclusions: I. No door is a cat. II. Some cats are not doors. III. Some cats are dogs. IV. All cats are dogs. Which conclusions logically follow?
questions.hindiQuestion: कथन: कोई दरवाजा कुत्ता नहीं है। सभी कुत्ते बिल्ली हैं। निष्कर्ष: I. कोई दरवाजा बिल्ली नहीं है। II. कुछ बिल्ली दरवाजे नहीं हैं। III. कुछ बिल्ली कुत्ते हैं। IV. सभी बिल्ली कुत्ते हैं। कौन-से निष्कर्ष तार्किक रूप से निकलते हैं?
questions.explanation: Since all dogs are cats, some cats are dogs (Conclusion III follows). Also, the dogs that are cats cannot be doors, meaning those particular cats are definitely not doors (Conclusion II follows). Hence Only II and III follow.
questions.verificationNote: Question completed: The conclusions were omitted in some copies of the original test paper and have been reconstructed rigorously from the two given statements.

questions.question: Statements: All poles are guns. Some boats are not poles. Conclusions: I. All guns are boats. II. Some boats are not guns.
questions.hindiQuestion: कथन: सभी खंभे बंदूकें हैं। कुछ नावें खंभे नहीं हैं। निष्कर्ष: I. सभी बंदूकें नावें हैं। II. कुछ नावें बंदूकें नहीं हैं।

options.A: If either I or II follows
options.C: If neither I nor II follows

questions.answerText: If neither I nor II follows
questions.explanation: From 'All poles are guns' and 'Some boats are not poles', we cannot conclude that all guns are boats (I does not follow). Nor can we definitively conclude that some boats are not guns (as all boats could potentially be inside guns while outside poles). Therefore, neither follows.

questions.question: Statements: I. The Government has decided to hold a single entrance test for admission to all the medical colleges in India. II. The State Government has debarred students from other States from applying for the seats in the medical colleges in the State. Which option correctly shows the relationship between the two statements?
questions.hindiQuestion: कथन: I. सरकार ने भारत के सभी मेडिकल कॉलेजों में प्रवेश के लिए एक ही प्रवेश परीक्षा आयोजित करने का निर्णय लिया है। II. राज्य सरकार ने अन्य राज्यों के छात्रों को राज्य के मेडिकल कॉलेजों में सीटों के लिए आवेदन करने से रोक दिया है। दोनों कथनों के बीच संबंध क्या है?

options.A: Both statements I and II are effects of some common cause.
options.B: Statement I is the cause and statement II is its effect.
options.C: Both statements I and II are independent causes.
options.D: Statement II is the cause and statement I is its effect.

questions.answerText: Both statements I and II are effects of some common cause.
questions.explanation: Both statements represent distinct administrative policy decisions responding to the broader prevailing issues in medical entrance examinations and seat allocation systems; thus both are effects of some common cause.

questions.question: If the words are arranged according to the dictionary, what will come in the second place from the last? 1. Spastically 2. Spasmatic 3. Spasticity 4. Spastic 5. Spasmodical
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि शब्दों को शब्दकोश के अनुसार व्यवस्थित किया जाए, तो अंत से दूसरे स्थान पर कौन-सा शब्द आएगा? 1. Spastically 2. Spasmatic 3. Spasticity 4. Spastic 5. Spasmodical
questions.explanation: Alphabetical order: 1st: Spasmatic, 2nd: Spasmodical, 3rd: Spastic, 4th: Spastically, 5th: Spasticity. From the last, 5th is Spasticity (1st from last), and 4th is Spastically (2nd from last). So Spastically is in the second place from the last.

questions.question: In a row of pigeons, all are facing north. P1 is 9th from the left end and P2 is 12th from the right end. There are three peacocks between P1 and P2. P1 and P3 are equidistant from P4. Find how many pigeons are there in the row.
questions.hindiQuestion: कबूतरों की एक पंक्ति में सभी उत्तर की ओर उन्मुख हैं। P1 बाएं छोर से 9वें और P2 दाएं छोर से 12वें स्थान पर है। P1 और P2 के बीच तीन मोर हैं। P1 और P3, P4 से समान दूरी पर हैं। पंक्ति में कितने कबूतर हैं?
questions.explanation: The positions of P3 and P4 and overlapping versus non-overlapping conditions are not definitively fixed, and peacock vs pigeon count is ambiguous. Hence the total cannot be determined.
questions.verificationNote: The relative positions of P3 and P4 and whether birds overlap are not uniquely specified; hence the total cannot be determined.

questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘@’ represents ‘+’, ‘⊕’ represents ‘−’, ‘α’ represents ‘÷’ and ‘θ’ represents ‘×’. Find the answer to: 8900 α 100 ⊕ 5 θ 4 ⊕ 121 α 11 = ?

question.en: Replace the question mark (?) in the following number series with suitable option: 3, 3, 4.5, 9, 22.5, ?
question.hi: निम्नलिखित संख्या श्रृंखला में प्रश्न चिन्ह (?) को उपयुक्त विकल्प से बदलें : 3, 3, 4.5, 9, 22.5, ?

explanation.en: The multiplier increases by 0.5 at each step: 3 × 1 = 3; 3 × 1.5 = 4.5; 4.5 × 2 = 9; 9 × 2.5 = 22.5; 22.5 × 3 = 67.5.

question.en: N is more intelligent than M. M is not as intelligent as Y. X is more intelligent than Y but not as intelligent as N. Who is the most intelligent of all?
question.hi: N, M से अधिक बुद्धिमान है। M, Y जितना बुद्धिमान नहीं है। X, Y से अधिक बुद्धिमान है लेकिन N जितना बुद्धिमान नहीं है। सभी में सबसे अधिक बुद्धिमान कौन है?

explanation.en: From the given conditions: N > X > Y > M. Therefore, N is the most intelligent of all.
explanation.hi: दिए गए कथनों के अनुसार: N > X > Y > M। अतः सबसे अधिक बुद्धिमान N है।

question.en: First day of a leap year is Wednesday, then what day of the week was it on 31st December in that year?
question.hi: लीप वर्ष का पहला दिन बुधवार है, तो उस वर्ष 31 दिसंबर को सप्ताह का कौन-सा दिन था?

explanation.en: A leap year has 366 days (52 weeks and 2 odd days). Thus, the last day of a leap year falls on the day after its first day: Wednesday + 1 = Thursday.
explanation.hi: लीप वर्ष में 366 दिन होते हैं। किसी लीप वर्ष का 31 दिसंबर उसके 1 जनवरी के दिन से एक दिन आगे होता है: बुधवार + 1 = गुरुवार।

question.en: Find the odd one from the following.
question.hi: निम्नलिखित में से सर्वथा भिन्न ज्ञात कीजिए।

explanation.en: Salty, Sour, and Sweet are specific tastes perceived by taste buds, whereas 'Tasteless' denotes the complete absence of taste.
explanation.hi: नमकीन, खट्टा तथा मीठा विशिष्ट स्वाद के प्रकार हैं, जबकि 'बेस्वाद' स्वाद के अभाव को दर्शाता है। अतः 'बेस्वाद' भिन्न है।

question.en: Vinod introduces, Vishal as the son of the only brother of his father's wife. How is Vinod related to Vishal?
question.hi: विनोद ने विशाल को अपने पिता की पत्नी के इकलौते भाई के बेटे के रूप में पेश किया। विनोद का विशाल से क्या संबंध है?

explanation.en: Father's wife = Mother. Mother's only brother = Maternal uncle (मामा). Maternal uncle's son = Cousin (ममेरा भाई / फुफेरा भाई).
explanation.hi: पिता की पत्नी = माता। माता का इकलौता भाई = मामा। मामा का बेटा = ममेरा भाई (Cousin)।

questions.question: What is the ratio of the total products sold by Companies P and R in March to the total sold by the same companies in April?
questions.hindiQuestion: मार्च में कंपनी P और R द्वारा बेचे गए कुल उत्पादों का अप्रैल में उन्हीं कंपनियों द्वारा बेचे गए कुल उत्पादों से अनुपात क्या है?

questions.question: What is the difference between the combined sales of Company Q in January and May and Company R in those same months?
questions.hindiQuestion: जनवरी और मई में कंपनी Q की संयुक्त बिक्री और उन्हीं महीनों में कंपनी R की संयुक्त बिक्री के बीच का अंतर क्या है?
questions.explanation: Company Q in Jan + May = 80 + 120 = 200. Company R in Jan + May = 155 + 130 = 285. Difference = 285 − 200 = 85.

questions.question: If 60% of Company E's account employees and 40% of its research employees have MBA degrees, how many employees of Company E have MBA degrees?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि कंपनी E के लेखा (account) कर्मचारियों में से 60% और अनुसंधान (research) कर्मचारियों में से 40% के पास MBA की डिग्री है, तो कंपनी E के कितने कर्मचारियों के पास MBA की डिग्री है?
questions.explanation: Company E Total = 350. Account employees % = 12% + 18% = 30% => 0.30 × 350 = 105. 60% of 105 = 63. Research employees % = 3% + 7% = 10% => 0.10 × 350 = 35. 40% of 35 = 14. Total MBA holders = 63 + 14 = 77.

questions.question: What is the ratio of female account employees in Company B to male research employees in Company C?
questions.hindiQuestion: कंपनी B में महिला लेखा कर्मचारियों और कंपनी C में पुरुष अनुसंधान कर्मचारियों का अनुपात क्या है?
questions.explanation: Female account employees in B = 10% of 700 = 70. Male research employees in C = 4% of 550 = 22. Ratio = 70 : 22 = 35 : 11.

questions.question: The number of account employees in Company A is approximately what percent more than the number of research employees in Company E?
questions.hindiQuestion: कंपनी A में लेखा कर्मचारियों की संख्या, कंपनी E में अनुसंधान कर्मचारियों की संख्या से लगभग कितने प्रतिशत अधिक है?
questions.explanation: Account employees in A = 26% of 450 = 117. Research employees in E = 10% of 350 = 35. Difference = 117 − 35 = 82. % more = (82 / 35) × 100 ≈ 234.29%.

questions.question: What is the ratio of male account employees in Companies A and C together to female research employees in Companies B and D together?
questions.hindiQuestion: कंपनी A और C में मिलाकर पुरुष लेखा कर्मचारियों का कंपनी B और D में मिलाकर महिला अनुसंधान कर्मचारियों से अनुपात क्या है?
questions.explanation: Male account in A & C = 54 + 154 = 208. Female research in B & D = 91 + 24 = 115. Ratio = 208 : 115.

questions.question: What is the difference between female account employees in all companies except D and male research employees in all companies except A and E?
questions.hindiQuestion: D को छोड़कर सभी कंपनियों में महिला लेखा कर्मचारियों और A तथा E को छोड़कर सभी कंपनियों में पुरुष अनुसंधान कर्मचारियों के बीच का अंतर क्या है?

questions.question: If the male population above the poverty line in State C is 1.5 million, what is State C's total population?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि राज्य C में गरीबी रेखा से ऊपर पुरुषों की जनसंख्या 1.5 मिलियन है, तो राज्य C की कुल जनसंख्या क्या है?
questions.explanation: In State C, % above poverty line = 75%. Ratio of M : F above poverty line = 2 : 3. Male fraction = 2/5 of 75% = 30% of total population. If 30% = 1.5 million, Total population = 1.5 / 0.30 = 5 million.

questions.question: What is the number of females above the poverty line in State D if its population is 7 million?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि राज्य D की जनसंख्या 7 मिलियन है, तो राज्य D में गरीबी रेखा से ऊपर महिलाओं की संख्या क्या है?
questions.explanation: Population above poverty line in State D = 80% of 7 million = 5.6 million. Female fraction = 3 / (4 + 3) = 3/7. Females above poverty line = (3/7) × 5.6 = 2.4 million.

questions.question: What is the approximate male population above the poverty line in State A if the female population below the poverty line is 1.8 million?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि राज्य A में गरीबी रेखा से नीचे महिलाओं की जनसंख्या 1.8 मिलियन है, तो राज्य A में गरीबी रेखा से ऊपर पुरुषों की अनुमानित जनसंख्या क्या है?
questions.explanation: Females below poverty line in A = 6/11 of Below-poverty population = 1.8 M => Below-poverty population = 1.8 × 11 / 6 = 3.3 million. Since below poverty line is 30%, Total population = 3.3 / 0.30 = 11 million. Population above poverty line (70%) = 7.7 million. Males above = 6/13 × 7.7 million ≈ 3.5538 million ≈ 3.55 million.
questions.verificationNote: Stem corrected: The original question printed 'above' the poverty line where 'below' was required to match the calculation: Female below = 1.8M => Total = 11M => Male above = 7.7 × 6/13 ≈ 3.55 M.

questions.question: If males below the poverty line number 2.4 million in State B and 6 million in State E, what is the ratio of the total populations of States B and E?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि राज्य B में गरीबी रेखा से नीचे पुरुषों की संख्या 2.4 मिलियन है और राज्य E में 6 मिलियन है, तो राज्य B और E की कुल जनसंख्या का अनुपात क्या है?
questions.explanation: In B: Males below = (3/8) × 0.20 × Pop(B) = 0.075 Pop(B) = 2.4 M => Pop(B) = 2.4 / 0.075 = 32 million. In E: Males below = (5/8) × 0.15 × Pop(E) = 0.09375 Pop(E) = 6 M => Pop(E) = 6 / 0.09375 = 64 million. Ratio Pop(B) : Pop(E) = 32 : 64 = 1 : 2.

questions.question: If State C has a total population of 4 million, how many females are above the poverty line?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि राज्य C की कुल जनसंख्या 4 मिलियन है, तो गरीबी रेखा से ऊपर महिलाओं की संख्या कितनी है?
questions.explanation: Population above poverty line in State C = 75% of 4 million = 3 million. Female share = 3 / (2 + 3) = 3/5. Number of females = (3/5) × 3 million = 1.8 million.

questions.question: What are the approximate average marks obtained by all seven students in English?
questions.hindiQuestion: सभी सात छात्रों द्वारा अंग्रेजी (अधिकतम 120) में प्राप्त अनुमानित औसत अंक क्या हैं?
questions.explanation: English max marks = 120. Percentages: 50, 85, 70, 65, 90, 80, 80. Sum of percentages = 520%. Average percentage = 520 / 7 ≈ 74.285%. Average marks = 74.285% of 120 = 89.14 ≈ 89.

questions.question: How many students obtained 60% and above marks in all subjects?
questions.hindiQuestion: कितने छात्रों ने सभी विषयों में 60% और उससे अधिक अंक प्राप्त किए?
questions.explanation: Inspecting each student's percentages: Ankit has Maths 35% (<60%); Brijesh has Hindi 50% (<60%); Chirag: 90, 60, 70, 70, 90, 70 (all >= 60%); Divyesh has Hindi 40% (<60%); Ehan has Maths 50% (<60%); Faruk has Biology 40% (<60%); Gautam: 80, 65, 80, 80, 60, 60 (all >= 60%). Exactly 2 students (Chirag and Gautam) scored >= 60% in all subjects.

questions.question: What were Ehan's aggregate marks in all six subjects?
questions.hindiQuestion: सभी छह विषयों में एहान (Ehan) के कुल प्राप्तांक कितने थे?

questions.question: In which subject is the overall percentage lowest?
questions.hindiQuestion: किस विषय में समग्र (overall) प्रतिशत सबसे कम है?
questions.explanation: Sum of percentages across the 7 students: Maths has the lowest sum (35 + 65 + 60 + 75 + 50 + 80 + 65 = 430%), making its overall average percentage lowest among the choices.

questions.question: What is Brijesh's approximate overall percentage?
questions.hindiQuestion: बृजेश का अनुमानित समग्र प्रतिशत क्या है?
questions.explanation: Total marks scored by Brijesh = 120 + 84.5 + 102 + 95 + 30 + 36 = 467.5. Total maximum marks = 150 + 130 + 120 + 100 + 60 + 40 = 600. Overall percentage = (467.5 / 600) × 100 ≈ 77.92% ≈ 78%.

questions.question: Which type of car manufactured by company X during 2016–2021 had the maximum production?
questions.hindiQuestion: 2016-2021 के दौरान कंपनी X द्वारा निर्मित किस प्रकार की कार का उत्पादन अधिकतम था?

questions.question: What was the approximate percentage increase in production of car A from 2016 to 2021?
questions.hindiQuestion: 2016 से 2021 तक कार A के उत्पादन में लगभग कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि हुई?

questions.question: Which type of car registered a continuous increase in production over the years?
questions.hindiQuestion: किस प्रकार की कार ने इन वर्षों के दौरान उत्पादन में निरंतर वृद्धि दर्ज की?
questions.explanation: Checking each: A decreases from 2019 to 2020 (260->230). B drops. C drops from 2017 to 2018 (228->212). D and E also fluctuate. None of the car types registered continuous year-over-year increase.

questions.question: Car E production in 2016 was approximately what percentage of car B production in 2019?
questions.hindiQuestion: 2016 में कार E का उत्पादन, 2019 में कार B के उत्पादन का लगभग कितना प्रतिशत था?

questions.question: What was the approximate percentage decrease in production of car D from 2018 to 2021?
questions.hindiQuestion: 2018 से 2021 तक कार D के उत्पादन में लगभग कितने प्रतिशत की कमी आई?

questions.question: The selling price of book A in store 1 is ₹395 and the difference between the selling prices in store 2 and store 3 is ₹36.825. What is the approximate discount percentage in store 2?
questions.hindiQuestion: दुकान 1 में पुस्तक A का विक्रय मूल्य ₹395 है और दुकान 2 तथा दुकान 3 में विक्रय मूल्य के बीच का अंतर ₹36.825 है। दुकान 2 में अनुमानित छूट प्रतिशत क्या है?

questions.question: The average selling price of book B in store 2 and store 3 is ₹594. What is the selling price of book B in store 2?
questions.hindiQuestion: दुकान 2 और दुकान 3 में पुस्तक B का औसत विक्रय मूल्य ₹594 है। दुकान 2 में पुस्तक B का विक्रय मूल्य क्या है?

questions.question: By selling book A, store 1 makes a profit of 10%. What is the approximate profit/loss percent incurred by store 3 on the same book? (Round off to the nearest integer.)
questions.hindiQuestion: पुस्तक A को बेचकर, दुकान 1 को 10% का लाभ होता है। उसी पुस्तक पर दुकान 3 द्वारा अर्जित अनुमानित लाभ/हानि प्रतिशत क्या है?

questions.question: The average selling price of book D in store 2 and store 3 is ₹1,480. What is the marked price of book D?
questions.hindiQuestion: दुकान 2 और दुकान 3 में पुस्तक D का औसत विक्रय मूल्य ₹1,480 है। पुस्तक D का अंकित मूल्य क्या है?

questions.question: The ratio of discount percentage on book C in store 1 and store 2 is 3 : 2. If the selling price in store 1 is ₹220, what is the approximate selling price in store 2?
questions.hindiQuestion: दुकान 1 और दुकान 2 में पुस्तक C पर छूट प्रतिशत का अनुपात 3 : 2 है। यदि दुकान 1 में विक्रय मूल्य ₹220 है, तो दुकान 2 में अनुमानित विक्रय मूल्य क्या है?
questions.explanation: Since discount in Store 1 = 12%, and ratio is 3:2, discount in Store 2 = (2/3) × 12% = 8%. SP1 = 0.88 MP = 220 => MP = 220 / 0.88 = ₹250. SP2 = 0.92 × 250 = ₹230.

questions.question: The amounts paid by family X on the phone, electricity and water bills in June were 12%, 16% and 25% higher than in May. Find the total amount paid by family X on all three bills in June.
questions.hindiQuestion: जून में परिवार X द्वारा फोन, बिजली और पानी के बिलों पर भुगतान की गई राशि मई की तुलना में क्रमशः 12%, 16% और 25% अधिक थी। जून में परिवार X द्वारा तीनों बिलों पर भुगतान की गई कुल राशि ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.question: What is the difference between the total amount paid on electricity bills by all three families in February and the total amount paid on phone bills by all three families in April?
questions.hindiQuestion: फरवरी में तीनों परिवारों द्वारा बिजली बिलों पर भुगतान की गई कुल राशि और अप्रैल में तीनों परिवारों द्वारा फोन बिलों पर भुगतान की गई कुल राशि के बीच का अंतर क्या है?

questions.question: What is the ratio of the total amount paid on phone bills to that on electricity bills over the five months by the family that paid the highest electricity bill in January?
questions.hindiQuestion: जनवरी में सबसे अधिक बिजली बिल का भुगतान करने वाले परिवार द्वारा पांच महीनों में फोन बिलों पर भुगतान की गई कुल राशि का बिजली बिलों से अनुपात क्या है?
questions.explanation: Highest electricity in Jan was Family Z (₹2500). Total Phone bills for Z = 1500 + 1350 + 1200 + 1250 + 1400 = ₹6,700. Total Electricity bills for Z = 2500 + 1400 + 2400 + 1250 + 1150 = ₹8,700. Ratio = 6700 : 8700 = 67 : 87 = 335 : 435.

questions.question: The average amount paid on water bills by family X is how much more/less than the average amount paid by family Y on water bills?
questions.hindiQuestion: परिवार X द्वारा पानी के बिलों पर भुगतान की गई औसत राशि, परिवार Y द्वारा पानी के बिलों पर भुगतान की गई औसत राशि से कितनी अधिक/कम है?

questions.question: The amount paid on phone bills by family Y is approximately what percent more than its amount paid on electricity bills over the given months?
questions.hindiQuestion: दिए गए महीनों में परिवार Y द्वारा फोन बिलों पर भुगतान की गई राशि, उसके बिजली बिलों पर भुगतान की गई राशि से लगभग कितने प्रतिशत अधिक है?
questions.explanation: Total Phone Y = 6150. Total Electricity Y = 5500. Excess = 6150 − 5500 = 650. % more = (650 / 5500) × 100 = 11.818% ≈ 12%.

questions.question: What is the average consumption of crude oil in each of the five countries in 2020?
questions.hindiQuestion: 2020 में पाँचों देशों में से प्रत्येक में कच्चे तेल की औसत खपत (Consumption) क्या थी? (खपत = उत्पादन + आयात − निर्यात)
questions.explanation: Consumption in 2020 = Production + Import − Export: Afghanistan = 2100 + 400 − 600 = 1900. Bangladesh = 1400 + 300 − 400 = 1300. Bhutan = 2000 + 400 − 800 = 1600. India = 2200 + 500 − 600 = 2100. Maldives = 700 + 1300 − 500 = 1500. Total Consumption = 1900 + 1300 + 1600 + 2100 + 1500 = 8400. Average = 8400 / 5 = 1680.

questions.question: What is the average consumption of crude oil in each of the five countries in 2022?
questions.hindiQuestion: 2022 में पाँचों देशों में से प्रत्येक में कच्चे तेल की औसत खपत क्या है?

questions.question: What is the export to import ratio of the five countries together in 2020?
questions.hindiQuestion: 2020 में पाँचों देशों को मिलाकर निर्यात और आयात का अनुपात क्या है?

questions.question: In 2022, which country’s import to consumption ratio was the highest among the following countries?
questions.hindiQuestion: 2022 में निम्नलिखित देशों में से किस देश का आयात और खपत का अनुपात सबसे अधिक था?
questions.explanation: In 2022, Maldives has Import = 1586 and Consumption = 1829. Ratio = 1586 / 1829 ≈ 0.867 (86.7%), which is far higher than any other country.

questions.question: The percentage increase in crude oil consumption from 2020 to 2022 is the highest for which of the following countries?
questions.hindiQuestion: 2020 से 2022 तक कच्चे तेल की खपत में प्रतिशत वृद्धि निम्नलिखित में से किस देश के लिए सबसे अधिक है?
questions.explanation: Consumption growth: Bangladesh = (1620 − 1300)/1300 = 320/1300 ≈ 24.615%; Bhutan = (1980 − 1600)/1600 = 380/1600 = 23.75%; Maldives = (1829 − 1500)/1500 = 329/1500 = 21.93%; Afghanistan = (2302 − 1900)/1900 = 402/1900 = 21.16%. Bangladesh has the highest percentage increase.

questions.question: Suppose A, B and C mix their solutions in one vessel. What would be the concentration of milk in the new solution? (approximately)
questions.hindiQuestion: मान लीजिए A, B और C अपने घोल को एक बर्तन में मिलाते हैं। नए घोल में दूध की सांद्रता लगभग क्या होगी?
questions.explanation: Total milk sold = 2000 litres. A gets 20% = 400 L pure milk; with 20% water concentration, milk concentration = 80%, so total solution = 400/0.8 = 500 L (water = 100 L). B gets 10% = 200 L pure milk; with 10% water, solution = 200/0.9 = 222.22 L (water = 22.22 L). C gets 10% = 200 L pure milk; with 15% water, solution = 200/0.85 = 235.29 L (water = 35.29 L). Total pure milk = 400 + 200 + 200 = 800 L. Total solution = 500 + 222.22 + 235.29 = 957.51 L. Concentration of milk = (800 / 957.51) × 100 ≈ 83.55%.

questions.question: Find the time taken by train A to pass train C if they are travelling in the same direction.
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि ट्रेन A और ट्रेन C एक ही दिशा में यात्रा कर रही हैं, तो ट्रेन A द्वारा ट्रेन C को पार करने में लिया गया समय ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Solving individual lengths and speeds from system of equations: Length(A) = 330 m, Length(C) = 530 m. Relative speed in same direction = |sA − sC| = 10 m/s. Crossing time = (330 + 530) / 10 = 860 / 10 = 86 seconds.
questions.verificationNote: Reading the upper curve as train lengths (in decametres) and lower curve as crossing times (in seconds) is the verified interpretation reconciling all questions Q463–Q467.
questions.graphDescription: Line graph for pairs of trains: Upper line = Sum of lengths in decametres (1 dm = 10 m): A+B = 60 dm (600 m), B+C = 80 dm (800 m), C+D = 70 dm (700 m), D+E = 50 dm (500 m), E+A = 66 dm (660 m). Lower line = Crossing time in opposite directions: A+B: 12 s, B+C: 20 s, C+D: 25 s, D+E: 10 s, E+A: 12 s.
questions.graphSvg: Graph Set 9: Pairwise Train Lengths (decametres) & Crossing Times (seconds)

questions.question: Find the approximate time taken by train B and train D to cross each other if both are travelling in opposite directions.
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि ट्रेन B और ट्रेन D दोनों विपरीत दिशाओं में यात्रा कर रही हैं, तो एक-दूसरे को पार करने में उनके द्वारा लिया गया अनुमानित समय ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Sum of lengths B + D = 270 + 170 = 440 m. Relative speed in opposite direction = sB + sD = 22 + 23 = 45 m/s. Time = 440 / 45 ≈ 9.777 s ≈ 9.78 seconds.
questions.graphDescription: Line graph for pairs of trains: Upper line = Sum of lengths in decametres (1 dm = 10 m): A+B = 60 dm (600 m), B+C = 80 dm (800 m), C+D = 70 dm (700 m), D+E = 50 dm (500 m), E+A = 66 dm (660 m). questions.explanation: Platform length: Distance = (Length E + L_plat) = 28 × 50 = 1400 m => L_plat = 1400 − 330 = 1070 m. For train D: Length D = 170 m, Speed D = 13.5 m/s. Total distance = 1070 + 170 = 1240 m. Time = 1240 / 13.5 ≈ 91.82 seconds.

questions.question: Train A was travelling from Patna to Delhi while train D was travelling from Delhi to Patna. Train A started 2 hours after train D. If both trains meet at a distance of 297 km from Delhi, find the approximate distance between Patna and Delhi.
questions.hindiQuestion: ट्रेन A पटना से दिल्ली जा रही थी जबकि ट्रेन D दिल्ली से पटना जा रही थी। ट्रेन A, ट्रेन D के 2 घंटे बाद चली। यदि दोनों ट्रेनें दिल्ली से 297 किमी की दूरी पर मिलती हैं, तो पटना और दिल्ली के बीच की अनुमानित दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Speed of Train D in km/h: Train D travels 297 km. Time taken by D = t. Train A travels for (t − 2) hours. Using the derived speed ratio and speeds, distance covered by Train A is ≈ 232.2 km. Total distance between Patna and Delhi = 297 + 232.2 = 529.2 km.

questions.graphDescription: Line graph: Sales of shoes (in thousands) from six stores (Kolkata, Patna, Dhanbad, Ranchi, Asansol, Gaya) during 2020, 2021, 2022. 2020: 140, 110, 150, 100, 150, 80 (Sum = 730, Avg = 730/6 = 121.67). 2021: 300, 120, 200, 200, 200, 270 (Sum = 1290).

questions.question: The total shoe sales of the Gaya store and Patna store together for three years are approximately what percent of the total sales of the Dhanbad store and Ranchi store together for three years?
questions.hindiQuestion: तीन वर्षों के लिए गया स्टोर और पटना स्टोर की कुल जूता बिक्री, धनबाद स्टोर और रांची स्टोर की तीन वर्षों की कुल बिक्री का लगभग कितना प्रतिशत है?
questions.explanation: Sum Gaya + Patna ≈ 950. Sum Dhanbad + Ranchi ≈ 1180. Percentage = (950 / 1180) × 100 ≈ 80.51%.

questions.question: What percent of the average sales of shoes at the Kolkata, Patna and Dhanbad stores in 2021 is the average sales of shoes at the Ranchi, Asansol and Gaya stores in 2022?
questions.hindiQuestion: 2021 में कोलकाता, पटना और धनबाद स्टोर में जूतों की औसत बिक्री का कितना प्रतिशत, 2022 में रांची, आसनसोल और गया स्टोर में जूतों की औसत बिक्री है?
questions.explanation: Average in 2022 = 800 / 3. Average in 2021 = 620 / 3. % = (800 / 620) × 100 ≈ 129.03%. (Note: Commission's published key mistakenly showed 77.5%, which is 620 / 800).
questions.verificationNote: As worded: 2022 average / 2021 average = 800 / 620 = 129.03%. The commission key showed 77.5%, which is the inverted ratio.
